questions.stem: A farmer wants to manage land sustainably while protecting local wildlife. Which approach would best achieve this?

options.text: Using large amounts of pesticides to maximise crop yield
Draining all nearby wetlands for additional farmland
Maintaining hedgerows, reducing pesticide use, and leaving some areas wild
Clearing all hedgerows to create larger fields

questions.explanation: Sustainable farming practices include maintaining hedgerows (which provide habitats for wildlife), reducing pesticide use (which prevents harm to non-target species), and leaving some areas wild as wildlife corridors. This balances food production with conservation.
